notes: Modified cash basis village, FY ended 9/30/2022, extracted like FY2023/FY2024. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (pp7-10); the Adjustments column eliminates 245,171 of interfund transfers, leaving transfers out 542 to the Airport enterprise fund (no Total-column transfers in). Loan Proceeds 17,950 (Street) -> debt_proceeds; Loan Repayments 3,420 (Grants Fund, under Other Financing Sources) -> other_financing. Roll-forward 1,699,120 + 583,118 - 1,796,318 + 17,950 + 3,420 - 542 = 506,748 (p10). Ending cash 506,748 = governmental funds balance sheet Total Assets (Cash in Bank 499,403 + Cash at County Treasurer 7,345, p6); beginning cash not printed. Business-type (Airport, Water, Sewer) from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p12) Totals column, measure net position as later years: 572,872 + 386,237 - 185,112 + 542 = 774,539; proprietary cash flows (p13) left null as later years. Grants (Grants Fund 107,928; Water Fund 128,286) print no grantor, so category other / Grants (the budget schedule's Federal Receipts: Grants 118,193 does not tie to either). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), because it includes capital assets and debt not in the fund balance sheet. Detail: governmental revenues and other financing per fund column of the governmental funds statement (p7, p9); governmental expenditures from the Schedule of Expenditures by object per fund (pp16-17; ties to each fund's total), so the statement's per-fund function lines are not repeated; General Fund object lines are put under general government (the fund also carries sanitation 34,158) with review. Business-type detail per fund column of the proprietary statement (p12). The Total Primary Government budget schedule (pp14-15) is a combined all-funds schedule and is not recorded.
